overview.text: In 2026, his bills became law requiring prosecutors to justify refiling dismissed charges, mandating PFAS disclosure in pesticides, and restricting undercover interrogations of young people. He called for oversight hearings on heat conditions at Donovan state prison. He has made supporting the American film industry an Assembly priority.
